required_knowledge: [Tier 2 derived] The memos distinguish modifiable lifestyle factors from factors such as age or inherited predisposition, in their own circulatory-disease contexts. [sources: biology_2022_internal_class_test_may_q4.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.4, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.5]
prerequisites: [Tier 2 derived] Read which controllability category and how many factors the question asks for. [sources: biology_2022_internal_class_test_may_q4.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.4, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.5]
required_reasoning: [Tier 2 derived] Classify a relevant risk by whether the person can change it rather than by how serious it sounds. [sources: biology_2022_internal_class_test_may_q4.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.4, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.5]
required_procedure: [Tier 2 derived] Identify the requested category; provide the requested number of relevant risk factors in that category. [sources: biology_2022_internal_class_test_may_q4.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.4, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.5]
evidence_of_understanding: [Tier 2 derived] Supplies category-appropriate examples and can justify their placement without confusing a symptom with a risk factor. [sources: biology_2022_internal_class_test_may_q4.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.4, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.5]
marking_requirements: [Tier 2 derived] The hypertension memo explicitly separates controlled and uncontrolled examples; the later paper asks for those categories in separate items. Marks follow category-appropriate examples, not a general disease description. [sources: biology_2022_internal_class_test_may_q4.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.4, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.5]
misconceptions: [Tier 3 possible belief, not observed] Any cause or symptom of circulatory illness answers either risk-factor category. [sources: biology_2022_internal_class_test_may_q4.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.4, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.3.5]

definition: [Tier 2 derived] Explain the consequence of altered oxygen delivery or demand using respiration/energy, in the malaria and exercise contexts. Not a terminology-recall family. [sources: biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q3.1.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.1]
subject: biology
required_knowledge: [Tier 2 derived] These memos connect oxygen delivery with respiration or energy availability in the exercise and red-cell-destruction contexts. [sources: biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q3.1.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.1]
prerequisites: [Tier 2 derived] Identify what changed in the scenario rather than merely naming an illness or activity. [sources: biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q3.1.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.1]
required_reasoning: [Tier 2 derived] Link the change in supply or demand to its cellular consequence. [sources: biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q3.1.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.1]
required_procedure: [Tier 2 derived] Describe the relevant oxygen change and connect it to respiration/energy in the stated scenario. [sources: biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q3.1.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.1]
evidence_of_understanding: [Tier 2 derived] Gives a causal chain rather than only a symptom or the statement that the heart rate changes. [sources: biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q3.1.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.1]
marking_requirements: [Tier 2 derived] Both memos credit oxygen and respiration/energy links. Local partial-credit rules are retained only in Pass 1 and unresolved_items. [sources: biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q3.1.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.1]
misconceptions: [Tier 3 possible belief, not observed] Naming fatigue or increased activity alone is a complete causal explanation. [sources: biology_2023_internal_class_test_october_q3.1.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q1.4.1]

definition: [Tier 2 derived] State the relationship supported by the supplied group or age data rather than restating an isolated measurement. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q2.2.4.B, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.2.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.5]
subject: biology
required_knowledge: [Tier 2 derived] A conclusion expresses the comparison or trend supported by the supplied biological data. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q2.2.4.B, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.2.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.5]
prerequisites: [Tier 2 derived] Identify the compared groups or the ordered variable in the results. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q2.2.4.B, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.2.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.5]
required_reasoning: [Tier 2 derived] Connect the relevant groups/values into a supported relationship rather than a single isolated observation. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q2.2.4.B, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.2.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.5]
required_procedure: [Tier 2 derived] Read the comparison requested; describe the direction or group difference supported by the data. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q2.2.4.B, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.2.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.5]
evidence_of_understanding: [Tier 2 derived] States the relationship and can locate its support in the provided data without claiming an untested cause. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q2.2.4.B, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.2.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.5]
marking_requirements: [Tier 2 derived] The memos credit the stated group comparison or direction of association; exact expected wording and mark totals remain item-specific. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q2.2.4.B, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.2.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.5]
misconceptions: [Tier 3 possible belief, not observed] A conclusion can be an unsupported explanation of why the result occurred, without stating the observed comparison. [sources: biology_2022_internal_cycle_test_february_q2.2.4.B, biology_2023_internal_paper1_july_q4.2.5, biology_2023_internal_paper1_november_q3.2.5]
